--- title: "[crawl.DirectoryCrawler]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Crawl local files and optionally cache converted markdown. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/crawl.py#L909-L1215){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python crawl.DirectoryCrawler(*, cache_dir=None, max_workers=1) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Use a `DirectoryCrawler` for local Markdown, notebooks, PDFs, text files, and other formats supported by `read_as_markdown()`. Directory traversal always reads the current filesystem state. The cache stores converted Markdown per file origin and is reused only when the current file hash and modification time still match the cached metadata. When the cache directory lives inside a crawled root, the crawler skips its own cache files. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [cache_dir]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool | str | Path | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Where to cache converted Markdown. `None` (default) disables caching. `True` uses `.raghilda/cache/directory` under the current working directory. A string or `Path` uses that location. [max_workers]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of worker threads used to convert files concurrently in `markdown_documents()`. Must be at least 1. Default is 1. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#ec7d14e0 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.crawl import CrawlScope, DirectoryCrawler crawler = DirectoryCrawler(cache_dir=True, max_workers=4) scope = CrawlScope( roots=["docs"], depth=3, include_patterns=[r".*\.(md|qmd|ipynb|pdf)$"], ) for document in crawler.markdown_documents(scope): print(document.origin) ``` ::: ## Methods {.doc-methods}
Name Description
fetch_raw() Read one local file origin and return its source metadata.
markdown_documents() Discover and convert all local files matched by a scope.
origins() Discover local file origins matched by a scope.
### [fetch_raw()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Read one local file origin and return its source metadata. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/crawl.py#L1055-L1116){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python fetch_raw(origin, *, cache_force_refresh=False) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} The returned `FetchedSource` points at the file on disk and records its size, modification time, content hash, and detected type label. When caching is enabled and the file is unchanged since the last conversion, the cached Markdown path is attached so that conversion can be skipped. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [origin]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A `file://` URI (or local path) identifying an existing file. [cache_force_refresh]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : When `True`, ignore any cached Markdown for this file so it will be reconverted. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [FetchedSource]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The source description for the file at `origin`. ::: ### [markdown_documents()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Discover and convert all local files matched by a scope. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/crawl.py#L1118-L1163){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python markdown_documents( scope, *, convert=None, progress=True, cache_force_refresh=False ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Combines `origins()` and `fetch_markdown()`, converting files concurrently using up to `max_workers` threads while preserving traversal order. When caching is enabled, converted Markdown is reused for files whose hash and modification time are unchanged. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [scope]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [CrawlScope]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The `CrawlScope` describing what to crawl. [convert]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Callable[[FetchedSource], MarkdownDocument] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional callable that turns a `FetchedSource` into a `MarkdownDocument`. When omitted, the default conversion is used. [progress]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Unused; accepted for interface compatibility. [cache_force_refresh]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : When `True`, reconvert files even when cached Markdown is present. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Iterator[MarkdownDocument]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A lazy iterator of converted documents, in traversal order. ::: ### [origins()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Discover local file origins matched by a scope. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/crawl.py#L962-L1053){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python origins(scope, *, progress=True, cache_force_refresh=False) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Walks each root in the scope, descending up to `scope.depth` directory levels, and yields a `file://` URI for every file that passes the scope's pattern and type filters. Symlinked directories and the crawler's own cache directory are skipped. Directory traversal always reflects the current filesystem state, so `progress` and `cache_force_refresh` have no effect here. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [scope]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [CrawlScope]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The `CrawlScope` describing what to crawl. `roots` may be directories or individual files. [progress]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Unused; accepted for interface compatibility. [cache_force_refresh]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Unused; accepted for interface compatibility. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Iterator[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A lazy iterator of unique `file://` origins, in sorted traversal order. :::
